Title: Software Engineer II
Description: Purpose Statement: We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer II to bridge the gap between industrial edge devices and cloud-native applications. In this role, you will develop Full Stack solutions, focusing on Back End logic , while integrating factory-floor protocols with cloud services. This position is unique: you will manage data from the physical layer to the cloud , ensuring high quality through automated Pipelines and rigorous QA testing standards. Key Job Accountabilities Edge & Industrial Integration: Develop and maintain interfaces using Node-RED and Litmus to collect data via TCP/IP, Modbus TCP, Open Protocol, and RS232. Full Stack Development: Build scalable services using C# and .NET in both Windows and Linux environments. WPF and Avalonia UI frameworks. Cloud & Data Engineering: Manage large-scale data ingestion into BigQuery and leverage Vertex AI for predictive analytics. DevOps & Infrastructure: Architect and manage CI/CD Pipelines using Azure DevOps, deploying services within Containers (Docker/Kubernetes). Quality Assurance: Act as a champion for Quality by performing QA tester functions for your code, including unit testing, integration testing, and system-level validation. Observability & Reporting: Create real-time monitoring dashboards in Grafana and business intelligence reports in Power BI. Agile Collaboration: Execute tasks within an Agile Methodology framework, utilizing Azure Dev Ops for sprint planning and issue tracking. Education/Experience Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree required with 2 or more years of related experience preferred. Experience: 3–5 years in software engineering with a focus on industrial automation or IoT systems. Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of TCP/IP networking and serial communication (RS232). Hybrid Environments: Experience developing for Windows while deploying modern services on Linux via Containers. Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in SQL and the ability to visualize complex datasets for stakeholders. Testing Rigor: Strong background in Quality assurance; comfortable writing test plans and acting as a QA tester for feature releases. Communication: Ability to translate hardware-level data into actionable cloud-based insights. Other Qualifications Experience with RabbitMQ for high-reliability message queuing in industrial settings. Hands-on experience with Litmus for edge device management. Certifications in GCP or Azure DevOps. Title: Soc Functional Validation Engineering Intern
Description: Job Details Job Description: This position requires candidates to upload a resume in English; you are welcome to upload multiple versions of your resume if you prefer but an English version of your resume will be required to be considered for this position. We are seeking a motivated and talented Functional Validation Engineer Intern to join our dynamic and innovative team. In this internship role, you will gain hands-on experience supporting SoC (System on Chip) development activities, focusing on learning about functionality, performance and quality validation of our cutting-edge integrated SoCs. You will work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to learn testing strategies, assist in developing test content, support validation plans and participate in debugging activities to ensure SoCs meet functional operational goals. This internship provides an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in semiconductor validation while contributing to our customers' success under the guidance of senior engineers. Responsibilities The primary responsibilities for this internship will include, but are not limited to: Pre-Silicon Validation Support: Assist in developing and executing Pre-Silicon validation plans, gaining experience with various pre-silicon environments like Simics/VP, FPGA, Zebu SLE and HSLE models, to support SoC design correctness and functionality verification before manufacturing. Post-Silicon Validation Assistance: Support post-Silicon validation activities under supervision, learning about functionality and performance validation of SoC IPs. Learning and Development: Participate in training sessions, technical reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities to build expertise in validation methodologies and tools. A successful intern candidate should demonstrate the following skills and behavioral traits: Teamwork: Work collaboratively as part of a high-performance team and eagerness to learn from experienced team members. Commitment and Discipline: Commitment to learning and delivering assigned tasks on time and with accuracy. Growth Mindset: Demonstrated eagerness to learn, ask questions, and take on new challenges. Communication: Good presentation skills and proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Organization: Basic organizational skills and ability to manage assigned tasks effectively. Problem-solving aptitude for continuous learning and improvement. Qualifications Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research. Minimum Qualifications Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronical Engineering, System Engineering, Mechatronics or equivalent field. 6 months of experience in: Computer architecture, CPU architecture fundamentals, and SoC architecture. Programming languages such as C, C++ or Python. System architecture and SoC microarchitecture. Advance English level. Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship). Preferred Qualifications Exposure to hardware or firmware development projects. Passion for innovation and a proactive approach to challenges. Interest in exploring a long-term career in silicon architecture or related fields. A candidate who accepts an offer of employment in Mexico is required to present their own personal identification information and numbers for the following: Mexican Security Number (NSS), Tax Identification Number (RFC) and CURP identification number. Job Type Student / Intern Shift Shift 1 (Mexico) Primary Location: Mexico, Guadalajara Additional Locations: Business Group At the Data Center Group (DCG), we're committed to delivering exceptional products and delighting our customers. We offer both broad-market Xeon-based solutions and custom x86-based products, ensuring tailored innovation for diverse needs across general-purpose compute, web services, HPC, and AI-accelerated systems. Our charter encompasses defining business strategy and roadmaps, product management, developing ecosystems and business opportunities, delivering strong financial performance, and reinvigorating x86 leadership. Join us as we transform the data center segment through workload driven leadership products and close collaboration with our partners. Title: Data Analyst
Description: Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. To support our extraordinary teams that build great products and contribute to our growth, we are looking to add a Data Analyst located in Guadalajara, North Site . Reporting to the Director, Quality , the role involves the responsibility of providing technical support in the collection, analysis, and interpretation of quality data, transforming raw information into clear and actionable insights that support strategic business decision‑making and continuous process improvement. What a typical day looks like: Collect, prepare, and consolidate quality data from multiple sources (Excel, Power BI, ERP, APIs, MES, among others). Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, comparisons, and predictions related to quality and performance. Transform raw data into clear and actionable information for decision‑making. Create reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel. Translate technical findings into meaningful insights for leadership and non‑technical teams (Data Storytelling). Provide data‑driven recommendations to optimize processes, costs, quality, and performance. Deliver analytical support to areas such as operations, quality, finance, sales, and supply chain. Ensure the integrity, consistency, and availability of quality data. Link quality metrics (Scrap, Rework, COPQ) to financial and business impact. The experience we are looking to add to our team: Experience in data analysis and quality metrics within industrial or manufacturing environments. Knowledge of quality tools and operational performance metrics. Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel). Knowledge of SQL, DAX, and database management. Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python (desirable). Strong ability to communicate technical results clearly to non‑technical audiences. Intermediate English. Advanced Excel. Advanced experience with AI tools. What you’ll receive for the great work you provide: Competitive Salary. Medical and life insurance. Christmas bonus.
